/-!
External theorem: the all-minors matrix-tree theorem for a finite loopless edge-copy multigraph.

Source: S. Chaiken, "A combinatorial proof of the all minors matrix tree theorem", SIAM J.
Algebraic Discrete Methods 3 (1982), equation (2); complete proof in A. Zernik, "Taylor expansion
proof of the matrix tree theorem, part II", arXiv:1308.2160v1, Theorem 2 with Definition 4.

The matrix is the positive Laplacian `L x y = ∑ e, (δ x (left e) - δ x (right e)) *
(δ y (left e) - δ y (right e))`, with every original copy counted once. Rows `I` and columns `J`
are deleted and the remaining indices are enumerated increasingly. Forests are rooted at `I`; the
permutation `π` pairs the `r`-th element of `I` with the `π r`-th element of `J` in the same tree.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace FiniteAvalanches.External

open FiniteAvalanches.Trees
open scoped BigOperators Classical

axiom allMinors_matrixTree {n k : ℕ} {E : Type} [Fintype E]
    (G : Multigraph (Fin n) E) (I J : Finset (Fin n)) (hI : I.card = k) (hJ : J.card = k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ((Matrix.of (fun x y : Fin n => ∑ e : E,
          ((if x = G.left e then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if x = G.right e then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
            ((if y = G.left e then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (if y = G.right e then (1 : ℝ) else 0))) :
        Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).submatrix
      (Iᶜ.orderEmbOfFin (show Iᶜ.card = n - k by rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, hI]))
      (Jᶜ.orderEmbOfFin (show Jᶜ.card = n - k by rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, hJ]))).det =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((∑ x ∈ I, (x : ℕ)) + (∑ y ∈ J, (y : ℕ))) *
        ∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), ((Equiv.Perm.sign π : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          (Nat.card {F : Finset E // G.is_rooted_forest (I : Set (Fin n)) F ∧
            ∀ r : Fin k, G.reaches F (I.orderEmbOfFin hI r) (J.orderEmbOfFin hJ (π r))} : ℝ)

end FiniteAvalanches.External

/-- Wilson's theorem on a finite connected network whose parallel edge copies are distinct
elements: run an independent walk (each step a uniform incident copy) from the first
unretained vertex of an ordering of the non-root vertices, loop-erase it chronologically and
attach it. The result is a uniform spanning tree of edge copies.
Lyons–Peres, *Probability on Trees and Networks* (2016), Theorem 4.1 and pp. 96–100. -/
axiom wilson_classical_tree_probability
    {V E I : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Nontrivial V]
    (G : Multigraph V E) (hconn : ∀ x y : V, G.reaches Finset.univ x y) (ι : E ↪ I)
    (r : V) (order : List V) (hnodup : order.Nodup) (hspan : ∀ v : V, v ∈ order ↔ v ≠ r)
    (T : G.SpanningTree) :
    driversLaw G (uniformLetterLaw G hconn)
        {ω | ∃ s, classicalExplore G ι (initialState ⟨{r}, Set.singleton_nonempty r⟩) order ω =
            some s ∧ s.edges = T.val} =
      (Fintype.card G.SpanningTree : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

end FiniteAvalanches.External

(equivalently Theorem 4.1, p.59, plus finite layer-cake). -/

    {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (Q₁ Q₂ : Matrix E E ℝ)
    (hQ₁s : Q₁.IsSymm) (hQ₁i : Q₁ * Q₁ = Q₁)

    (p₁ p₂ : Finset E → ℝ) (hp₁ : ∀ S, 0 ≤ p₁ S) (hp₂ : ∀ S, 0 ≤ p₂ S)
    (hdet₁ : ∀ A : Finset E, ∑ S, Set.indicator {S : Finset E | A ⊆ S} p₁ S =
      (Q₁.submatrix (fun a : A => (a : E)) (fun a : A => (a : E))).det)
    (hdet₂ : ∀ A : Finset E, ∑ S, Set.indicator {S : Finset E | A ⊆ S} p₂ S =

    {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (J : CopiedGraph V E)

/-! Classical geometric duality for finite connected plane multigraph drawings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace FiniteAvalanches.External
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.StatementGeometry
open FiniteAvalanches.Electrical.BSST
open scoped Classical

/-- The dual retains every original edge copy, crosses it once, and its faces
correspond to the original vertices with reversed double-dual orientation. -/
axiom finite_plane_geometric_dual :
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (D : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart D e)
    (_hc : (supportGraph J.left J.right).Preconnected),
    ∃ finiteFaces : Fintype (Face D),
      letI : Fintype (Face D) := finiteFaces
      let dualGraph : CopiedGraph (Face D) E :=
        ⟨fun e => negativeChartFace D e (charts e),
          fun e => positiveChartFace D e (charts e)⟩
      ∃ dualDrawing : Drawing dualGraph,
      ∃ dualCharts : ∀ e : E, Source.EdgeChart dualDrawing e,
      ∃ vertexFaces : V ≃ Face dualDrawing,
        (∀ F : Face D, dualDrawing.point F ∈ faceRegion D F) ∧
        (∀ v : V, D.point v ∈ faceRegion dualDrawing (vertexFaces v)) ∧
        (∀ (e f : E) (s t : ArcParameter),
          D.curve e s = dualDrawing.curve f t ↔
            e = f ∧ s.val = 1 / 2 ∧ t.val = 1 / 2) ∧
        (∀ (e : E) (t : ArcParameter),
          (t.val < 1 / 2 →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.left e)) ∧
          (1 / 2 < t.val →
            dualDrawing.curve e t ∈ faceRegion D (dualGraph.right e))) ∧
        (∀ e : E, ∃ radius : ℝ, 0 < radius ∧ radius < (charts e).radius ∧
          ∀ t : ArcParameter, |t.val - 1 / 2| < radius →
            (charts e).chart.map (dualDrawing.curve e t) = (1 / 2, t.val - 1 / 2)) ∧
        (∀ e : E,
          positiveChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.left e) ∧
          negativeChartFace dualDrawing e (dualCharts e) = vertexFaces (J.right e))

end FiniteAvalanches.External

axiom finite_plane_dual_bond_cycle : (
∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (Q : Drawing J)
    (charts : ∀ e : E, EdgeChart Q e) (A : Finset V),
  (∀ x y : V, x ∈ A → y ∈ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∈ A) x y) →
  (∀ x y : V, x ∉ A → y ∉ A →
    J.reaches (Finset.univ.filter fun e => J.left e ∉ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) x y) →
  ∀ marked : E,
    ((J.left marked ∈ A ∧ J.right marked ∉ A) ∨
      (J.right marked ∈ A ∧ J.left marked ∉ A)) →
  ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ vertices : Fin (m + 1) → Face Q,
    Function.Injective vertices ∧
    ∃ copies : Fin m ≃ {e : E // e ≠ marked ∧
      ((J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A))},

        (J.left e ∈ A ∧ J.right e ∉ A) ∨ (J.right e ∈ A ∧ J.left e ∉ A)).card ∧

          positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.castSucc ∧
          negativeChartFace Q (copies i).val (charts (copies i).val) = vertices i.succ)) ∧
      ((negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)) ∨
        (positiveChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices 0 ∧
          negativeChartFace Q marked (charts marked) = vertices (Fin.last m)))

/-- Punctured-plane inversion transports all copied curves and complement faces. -/
axiom plane_punctured_face_transport : (
  ∀ {V E E₀ : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype E₀]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (K : CopiedGraph V E₀) (D : Drawing J)
    (i : E₀ → E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hl : ∀ e, J.left (i e) = K.left e)
    (hr : ∀ e, J.right (i e) = K.right e)
    (F : Face (restrictDrawing D i hi hl hr)),
  let R := restrictDrawing D i hi hl hr
  ∃ p : Plane, ∃ hp : p ∉ drawingTrace D,
    p ∈ faceRegion R F ∧
    ∃ c : {z : Plane // z ≠ p} ≃ₜ {z : Plane // z ≠ (0, 0)},
      (∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
        (c z).val =
          ((z.val.1 - p.1) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2),
           -(z.val.2 - p.2) / ((z.val.1 - p.1)^2 + (z.val.2 - p.2)^2))) ∧
      ∃ D' : Drawing J,
        (∀ v, D'.point v = (c ⟨D.point v, by
          intro heq
          apply hp
          exact heq ▸ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self v) : D.point v ∈ drawingTrace D)⟩).val) ∧
        (∀ e t, D'.curve e t = (c ⟨D.curve e t, by
          intro heq
          apply hp
          exact heq ▸ (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, Set.mem_range_self t⟩) :
            D.curve e t ∈ drawingTrace D)⟩).val) ∧
        let R' := restrictDrawing D' i hi hl hr
        ∃ faces : Face R ≃ Face R',
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
            z.val ∈ faceRegion R G ↔ (c z).val ∈ faceRegion R' (faces G)) ∧
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ z : {z : Plane // z ≠ p},
            z.val ∈ closure (faceRegion R G) ↔
              (c z).val ∈ closure (faceRegion R' (faces G))) ∧
          (∀ G : Face R, ∀ v : V, incident R v G ↔ incident R' v (faces G)) ∧
          (∀ e : E, ∀ S : Set ArcParameter, ∀ t : ArcParameter,
            D.curve e t ∈ closure (D.curve e '' S) ↔
              D'.curve e t ∈ closure (D'.curve e '' S)) ∧
          ¬Bornology.IsBounded (faceRegion R' (faces F))
  )

end FiniteAvalanches.External

axiom plane_punctured_chart_face_transport : (∀ {V E : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (J : CopiedGraph V E) (Q : Drawing J)

    (Q' : Drawing J)
    (_hcurve : ∀ e t, Q'.curve e t = (c ⟨Q.curve e t, by
      intro heq
